primary_display_name_zh: 马库斯·维普萨尼乌斯·阿格里帕

birth.conversion_note: Exact birth year uncertain; 63 BCE commonly cited

short_description_en: Roman general, admiral, and administrator; close associate of Augustus. Victor at the Battle of Actium (31 BCE). Oversaw extensive public works in Rome (Pantheon, aqueducts, baths). Married to Augustus' daughter Julia; grandfather of Caligula and great-grandfather of Nero.
short_description_zh: 罗马将军、海军统帅和行政官，奥古斯都的亲密伙伴。亚克兴海战（前31年）的胜利者。主持罗马大规模公共工程（万神殿、引水渠、浴场）。娶奥古斯都之女尤利亚为妻，为卡利古拉之祖父、尼禄之曾外祖父。
